name: @eliteaai/elitea-cli
description: Launch Claude Code on top of EliteA and work with EliteA projects, agents and pipelines from the terminal

scripts.elitea-cli:agent-get: tsup --silent && npm run -s elitea-cli -- agents get
scripts.elitea-cli:agent-versions: tsup --silent && npm run -s elitea-cli -- agents versions
scripts.elitea-cli:agent-run: tsup --silent && npm run -s elitea-cli -- agents run
scripts.elitea-cli:pipelines: tsup --silent && npm run -s elitea-cli -- pipelines list
scripts.elitea-cli:pipeline-get: tsup --silent && npm run -s elitea-cli -- pipelines get
scripts.elitea-cli:pipeline-versions: tsup --silent && npm run -s elitea-cli -- pipelines versions
scripts.elitea-cli:pipeline-run: tsup --silent && npm run -s elitea-cli -- pipelines run
scripts.elitea-cli:agent-chat: tsup --silent && npm run -s elitea-cli -- agents chat
scripts.elitea-cli:claude: tsup --silent && npm run -s elitea-cli -- launch claude
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm test && npm run typecheck && npm run build

author: EliteA
